name: Yeni Cami
source: Built for the Istanbul 3D map (Groker, 4 Nov 2026) from the OSM outline r7574356 (+ w939052267 as the Hünkâr Kasrı [doğrulanmadı]) (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL); figures from landmarks_sources.md §3 ([C1] DİA, [C2] MCID, [C3] Tekindağ, [C4] AGS 2012 rölöve); present-day state; toy style. Shape references: Doğancan's photo and memory note (never textures).

anchor.what: model origin = main dome centre (hall centre on the court axis), ground level (harim floor ±0 [C4])

rotation_meaning: compass bearing of the model +X axis (model is in map axes: +X east, +Z south)
ground: y = 0 (flat); the map adds terrain height at the anchor only

heights_m.plan: court from the OSM outline r7574356; hall drawn to [C4] harim 39.40 × 46.30 m + ≈4.5 m side galleries (checked against Doğancan's Apple Maps top view, 4 Nov); court 39.40 × 37.40 m [C4]
heights_m.main dome: outer r 9.1 m; cornice +31.13 m [C4]; inner crown +39.36 m [C4] -> outer crown ≈ 40.3 m (yaklaşık); 24 drum windows
heights_m.half-domes: 4 × r 8.2 m, crown ≈ 27 m [C4]; 8 exedrae r 3.3 m, crown ≈ 20.7 m (yaklaşık)
heights_m.pier turrets / corner domes: turrets to 30.4 m + small dome ≈ 32 m; corner domes r 4.2 m, crown ≈ 21.6 m (yaklaşık)
heights_m.minarets: 2 × 63.50 m, şerefe floors +31.00 / +37.00 / +44.00 m, base cornice +8.33 m [C4]
heights_m.courtyard: walls 9.0 m (yaklaşık), 19 portico domes (row at the hall larger), octagonal şadırvan ≈ 10.6 m with dome (yaklaşık)
heights_m.Hünkâr Kasrı: arcaded base 7 m + upper floor to 12 m + hip roof; stepped ramp 5.6 → 2.4 m (simple form, yaklaşık) [doğrulanmadı]
heights_m.Hatice Turhan Sultan Türbesi: ≈15 m square body, walls 11.5 m, octagonal drum to 14.0 m, dome Ø≈13 m, crown ≈19.7 m + alem; porch 15 m wide (≈6.4 m deep here; sources: 15 × 15 m) to 7 m with a central dome (yaklaşık) [doğrulanmadı]
heights_m.Yeni Cami Meydanı: paved (OSM w822870615), flush with the street

parts: hall (3 window rows, balustrade) + side galleries with small domes
main dome on a 24-window drum, 8 buttresses
Hatice Turhan Sultan Türbesi (domed, porch) on OSM w110009548
courtyard: domed portico, pale marble paving, octagonal marble şadırvan
